player_prompt.intro:
I ni jɛgɛ Player {player_id} kɔnɔ Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
I boli ni '{symbol}', ni i yɛrɛ tɛmɛnaw ni {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 walima O2, O4).

Jɛgɛ: Kɛlɛ ka wari boli fila sɔrɔ tɛmɛnaw kɔnɔ (superpositions).

Nin ye jɛgɛ:
- Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, sigi boli fila sɔrɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin lo de la '[a,b]'.
- O boli fila bɛɛ entangled, ni o boli fila tɔgɔ bɛɛ 'X1 / X1' walima 'O4 / O4'.
- I ma sigi boli fila sɔrɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin lo de la ka taa boli sɔrɔ (solidified).

Collapse Rule:
- Ni i yɛrɛ kɛlɛ ka wari boli fila sɔrɔ tɛmɛnaw kɔnɔ, o boli fila tɛmɛnaw sɔrɔ.
- Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, boli fila sɔrɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin lo de la ka taa boli sɔrɔ kɔnɔ.
- Ni boli fila sɔrɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin lo de la ka taa boli sɔrɔ, o boli fila tɛmɛnaw sɔrɔ.

Kɛlɛ:
- Jɛgɛ bɛɛni ni jɛgɛkɛlɛ boli fila sɔrɔ tɛmɛnaw kɔnɔ.
- Ni jɛgɛkɛlɛ fila bɛɛ kɛlɛ ka wari boli fila sɔrɔ tɛmɛnaw kɔnɔ, o jɛgɛkɛlɛ fila tɛmɛnaw sɔrɔ.

Yɛrɛ tɛmɛnaw: '[0,4]' sigi boli fila sɔrɔ kɔnɔ 0 ni 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Seli sɛbɛnw tɛ se ka kɛ walima u bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ.

game_action.placed: Jokɔla {player_id} ka jɛkɔra a ye symbol kan bɛ superposition ɲɛ cell {pos_a} ani {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition daɲɛ. Cell ({r}, {c}) jɛn bɛ {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition kɔnɔnɔn cell daɲɛ. Cell ({r}, {c}) jɛn bɛ {symbol}.

outcome.win: Jiginni {player_id} bɛ sɔrɔ ni a ka biɲɛ ye ja!
